Supervise blocking provider calls

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-16
  description: |-
    Route synchronous Codex, Cursor, and Grok session operations through one bounded supervisor backed by the existing runnable-capacity authority. Retain physical-call capacity after caller timeouts, join tracked calls during bounded daemon drain, and preserve exact provider session ownership across blocking boundaries.
    
    Add deterministic coverage for two stuck calls with responsive MCP, Picker, and independent repository work; timeout-retained capacity; bounded drain; and the existing panic, fencing, recovery, and fault-scope contracts.
